propositions: The outbound mapper's _assignee_resolver is injected as an undeclared attribute via try/except, causing silent degradation to non-authoritative results if injection fails
Attribute-based collaboration hides bugs: PR #120's DC adapter copied the getattr pattern into a class where nothing set the attribute, making the entire authoritative branch dead code
The attribute assignment requires type: ignore[attr-defined] comments because the dependency is invisible to the type checker and exists on no Protocol
The resolver must be threaded explicitly as a keyword-only defaulted parameter through OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee and both Cloud and DC implementers
DC's constructor-bound resolver (per-client) and the core's per-issue resolver must coexist with the explicit parameter taking precedence, preserving current overwrite semantics
All four injection/discovery sites and their type: ignore comments must be eliminated while keeping observable resolution outcomes and the six-state parity test identical
